channel.title: Thijn Köhne — writing
channel.description: Notes on rendering, local-first software and how the projects are built.

item.title: A school planner is a distribution problem
item.description: W3Plan starts with the school's PTA export, but the import, the installer and the decision to keep student schedules local are what made it usable.

item.title: The hero is dithered, not blurred
item.description: How a full-screen 8×8 Bayer dither is built in one GLSL pass: recursive thresholds, two-CSS-pixel blocks, twelve levels and a palette that follows the time of day.

item.title: Plain files, no accounts
item.description: Four local-first projects, one rule: the data belongs in a folder the person can inspect. What that buys, what it costs, and where a database still earns its keep.
